n_start: Hello, friends! Let's find out why Hong Kong has four seasons.
n_m1: First, let's say hello. Can you tap Mimi the cat?
n_m2: Now find the big, bright Sun. Give it a tap!
n_m3: Look at the Earth. It does not stand up straight. It leans! Tap the Earth.
n_m3ok: See? The Earth leans to one side, and it always leans the same way.
n_m4: It's spring in Hong Kong. Now fly the Earth around the Sun, until Mimi gets to summer.
n_m4ok: It's summer! Mimi's side leans toward the Sun. The Sun is high in the sky, so Hong Kong is hot.
n_m5: Phew, it's hot! Which hat should Mimi wear? A sun hat, or a woolly hat?
n_m5ok: Yes! A sun hat for hot, sunny days.
n_m6: Keep flying! Take Mimi to autumn.
n_m6ok: It's autumn! The air is cool and dry. A lovely day to fly a kite.
n_m7: Fly on again, all the way to winter.
n_m7ok: Brrr! It's winter. Now Mimi's side leans away from the Sun. The Sun is low in the sky, so Hong Kong is cool.
n_m8: Mimi is cold. But somebody is having summer right now! Tap the friend who feels hot.
n_m8ok: That's right! Sam lives on the bottom half. When it's winter for Mimi, it's summer for Sam.
n_m9: Here's a tricky one. In summer, does Mimi's side lean toward the Sun, or away?
n_m9ok: You got it! Leaning toward the Sun makes summer. Leaning away makes winter.
n_m10: Last one! Fly the Earth back to spring.
n_m10ok: Spring again! One whole trip around the Sun is one whole year.
n_fin: You did it! The Earth leans as it goes around the Sun, and that's why Hong Kong has four seasons. Great job, everyone!
n_hint5: Hmm. It's very hot today. Which hat keeps the Sun away?
n_hint8: Look for the friend in the sun hat.
n_hint9: Remember, summer is hot. Which way gets more sunshine?
n_play: Play time! Fly the Earth around the Sun, and tap your friends.
n_e1: The Earth leans to one side.
n_e2: It always leans the same way.
a_hi: Hi! I'm Mimi! I live in Hong Kong, on the top half of the Earth.
a_sp1: Spring! I can smell the flowers.
a_sp2: It's warm, and a little bit rainy.
a_wi2: It's cold, but there's no snow in Hong Kong.
b_hi: Hello! I'm Sam! I live far, far away, on the bottom half of the Earth.
b_x: My seasons are the other way around from Mimi's!
b_sp1: Spring! The bees are making honey.
b_su1: It's summer for me! Time for a swim.
b_au1: Autumn! I love the cool air.
s_hi: Hello! I'm the Sun! I stay in the middle, and the Earth goes around me.
s_2: I'm just as far away all year. It's the lean that makes the seasons!
